title: The July Call – Ignored, Lost, and Proven True
summary: Ben Carter submitted a detailed safeguarding call on 21 June 2024 warning that Alanna O’Hare had already begun executing specific threats — including contacting HMRC and defaming him to an injury lawyer. This call contained forensic predictions of escalating harm. Despite its significance, Sussex Police never acted. Later, when the same call was re-submitted in July, and referenced during the November arrest period, the police stated they could not find the call or confirm whether it had ever been reviewed. The contradiction lies in their knowledge of the threats’ reality, their refusal to intervene, and the ultimate disappearance of the one call that proved premeditated, preventable abuse. This became known as 'The July Call'.
quotes: She said she would contact HMRC — and I found out she already had.
This is the call they never listened to — despite everything that followed being foretold.
They didn’t lose the call. They buried it.
Once I realised I was being coerced, my brain came alive. That’s what gaslighting does — it makes you forget you’re right.
